faqs.question: How do I get NRI clients for real estate?
faqs.answer: Run Meta and Google ads aimed at Indians in the countries and cities where they live, send them to a page with an NRI FAQ and a dated video walk-through, and reply on WhatsApp instantly with call slots in their own time zone. Then send monthly construction updates.

faqs.question: Where do most NRIs live?
faqs.answer: According to the Ministry of External Affairs (data as of January 2026), India has about 1.78 crore NRIs. The largest groups live in the UAE (about 43 lakh), Saudi Arabia (about 27 lakh) and the USA (about 23 lakh), followed by Canada and Kuwait.

faqs.question: Can NRIs buy property in India?
faqs.answer: Yes. Under the RBI's FEMA Master Direction, NRIs and OCIs can buy residential and commercial property in India without RBI permission. They cannot buy agricultural land, plantation property or farm houses, though inheritance is allowed. Buyers should confirm details with their bank or a chartered accountant.

faqs.question: How do NRIs pay for property in India?
faqs.answer: Through banking channels: inward remittance from abroad, or a debit to an NRE, FCNR(B) or NRO account in India. The RBI Master Direction says payment cannot be made by traveller's cheque or foreign currency notes, so cash and foreign notes are not an option.

faqs.question: Can NRIs take property sale money back abroad?
faqs.answer: Yes, subject to conditions in the RBI Master Direction, such as the property having been bought under the foreign exchange rules of the time through banking channels. For residential property, repatriation of sale proceeds is limited to not more than two properties.

faqs.question: How can an NRI buy property without travelling to India?
faqs.answer: Many NRIs give a family member in India a power of attorney to sign and register the property for them, pay through NRE, FCNR(B) or NRO accounts, and use live video calls with the sales team for site visits. A home loan from an Indian bank is also possible.

faqs.question: Which ads work best for NRI buyers?
faqs.answer: Meta ads targeted by country or city with separate ad sets per region, Google Search ads for searches such as 'flats in Noida for NRI', and YouTube walk-through videos. For audiences in the US, Canada and some European countries, Meta requires the housing Special Ad Category.

faqs.question: When should I call NRI leads?
faqs.answer: In their own working hours. Dubai is 1 hour 30 minutes behind India, Riyadh and Doha 2 hours 30 minutes behind, Singapore 2 hours 30 minutes ahead, London 4 hours 30 minutes or 5 hours 30 minutes behind, and New York 9 hours 30 minutes or 10 hours 30 minutes behind.

faqs.question: What should an NRI landing page include?
faqs.answer: The usual project facts plus an NRI FAQ on eligibility, payments, home loans and power of attorney, a dated video walk-through, WhatsApp as the main button, call slots shown in the buyer's time zone, and the RERA number with the developer's completed projects.
